summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing a CEO shareholder letter dated October 20, 2026, covering CDMO growth and extended cash runway following a completed financing and a newly expanded manufacturing services agreement. No securities transaction, ownership stake, or change-of-control event is disclosed. The new customer agreement carries roughly $5.1 million in committed base service fees, subject to performance and contractual terms, with Committed Customer Orders of about $8.1 million versus $1.9 million at year-end 2025. Uncommitted later phases add roughly $5.85 million indicative value, starting January 2027; management estimates runway to late 2027, potentially into Q3 2028. Ordinary business update; no deal terms to arbitrage.
